description:
In Socioboard (already open in Firefox at http://localhost), log in with email: admin@socioboard.local and password: Admin2024!, then navigate to the RSS Content Manager section and add a new RSS feed with the following details:

- Feed Name: BBC Technology News
- Feed URL: https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/technology/rss.xml

Save the feed. Make sure the feed appears in the RSS content manager list after adding.
